project.name: C1能量波_原版与时机版_4段32秒

shots.title: 01_C1原版_种子1
shots.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Photoreal cinematic live-action, 16:9. Shot on ARRI Alexa Mini LF with Cooke Panchro/i Classic primes and a 1/4 Black Pro-Mist filter; 35mm for relationships, 50mm for mid shots, 85mm for faces, T2.0–T2.8 shallow depth of field. Kodak Portra 400 film emulation, about 50% teal-orange grade: teal-leaning shadows, warm amber skin. Fine film grain, soft-focus diffusion, a gentle haze in the air, soft halation on highlights, edges of the frame evenly lit. Lightly handheld throughout: a real handheld micro-shake and breathing motion. Framing stays on the people: chest- or waist-up, with headroom, hands and the key props visible in the lower frame. Real skin texture, visible pores. Broken fluorescent tubes cast cold stripes across concrete pillars and shallow puddles in the underground garage. A 35mm medium two-shot holds steady in a derelict underground garage. A short-haired woman in a black motorcycle jacket and jeans stands at screen-left. A bald thug at screen-right rushes leftward with an iron bar in his right hand; a square concrete pillar stands behind him at the far right. Only these two occupy the garage. Nobody stands idle or poses for the camera. Every character is always occupied with some small piece of business — handling an object, finishing a movement, glancing at something off-topic. In every exchange one character acts while the other reacts, and reactions arrive a beat late, the way real people respond while their attention is still somewhere else. Small involuntary gestures (swallowing, shifting weight, thumb rubbing an edge, a delayed look-up) matter more than polished facial expressions. She raises her open right palm toward him. A small blue-white light gathers against its center and grows bright enough to wash her cheek and jacket sleeve with blue-white reflections. The frame remains free of subtitles, captions, title cards, and text overlays. Dialogue is audible speech only.

[Shot 2] At 00:01.700, the camera cuts to a 50mm close-up across the gap from the same side, holding a static shot. The woman's glowing right palm from Shot 1 thrusts rightward from the left edge. A compact blue-white wave crosses the visible gap and strikes the bald thug's chest on the right. His shoulders jerk backward at the impact as the light breaks against the fabric.

[Shot 3] At 00:03.000, the camera cuts to a 35mm medium shot of the bald thug from Shot 1, tracking rightward from the same side. His feet leave the wet floor and his whole body travels backward toward screen-right. He still grips the iron bar; the concrete pillar remains directly behind him on the right. The blue-white wave thins into short streaks along the same path.

[Shot 4] At 00:04.500, the camera cuts to a 50mm close-up of the right-side pillar, holding a static shot. The bald thug from Shot 1 strikes it back-first. Cracks radiate from the impact through the concrete, dust bursts downward, and his right fingers release the iron bar. The bar falls beside the pillar into the shallow puddle below as his weight slides down the concrete.

[Shot 5] At 00:06.000, the camera cuts to a 50mm medium two-shot across the garage from the same side, holding steady. The short-haired woman from Shot 1 remains left, her right palm now dark and her fingers faintly trembling. The bald thug sits slumped at the cracked pillar on the right, the iron bar lying in its puddle. Dust settles between them while the floor ripples widen and fade.

overall_soundscape: A tired fluorescent hum fills the garage beneath fast shoes splashing through shallow water. A sharp compressed rush follows the palm wave and a distinct heavy impact lands as the thug strikes concrete. Cracking concrete and falling grit give way to the iron bar's metallic clatter and splash, then the hum remains under settling dust.

non_diegetic_music: N/A
